title: Integer - date is a decimal number

source.quote: In the following table, the row header is the minuend (left side) and the column header is the subtrahend (right side).
source.supports: the Subtraction (-) table: INTEGER minus Date/time is REAL

source.quote: if a subtraction operation uses a date with any other data type, DAX converts both values to dates, and the return value is also a date
source.supports: the sentence under the table, which read alone gives a date: the other reading

source.quote: the integer corresponds to the number of days since December 30, 1899
source.supports: a date as a number is the count of days since 1899-12-30

derivation: 2024-01-01 is 45292 days after 1899-12-30: 2 days to 1900-01-01, then 124 years of 365 days = 45260, plus the 30 leap days of 1904 to 2020 (1900 is not a leap year). INTEGER - Date/time is REAL in the table: 45293 - 45292 = 1.0.
alternative: By the sentence under the table the result is a date: 1899-12-31T00:00:00 (dateTime), the number 1 as a date.
notes: The table and the sentence under it disagree for a date on the right side.
